# Gul Muhammad - Full-Stack & MERN Developer

> Official knowledge profile and documentation for Gul Muhammad, Full-Stack Software Developer based in Karachi, Pakistan.

## Overview
Gul Muhammad is a professional Full-Stack Software Developer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), Next.js, and RESTful API engineering. He is based in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan, and is pursuing an Advance Diploma in Software Engineering (ADSE) at Aptech Learning Center.
